verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents official and custom MCP servers letting AI clients (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) query 'subscription and invoice tools' directly, plus a full REST API covering subscriptions, invoices, quotes, exports and events (e.g. subscription_cancelled for delinquency) that an agent could use to answer billing questions. However, there's no explicit documentation or example of querying aggregate metrics like MRR or upcoming-renewal reports directly via MCP/API — missing for 10: explicit MRR/renewal-report query examples, independent hands-on confirmation of an agent successfully answering these billing questions.
